whatItIs: QCViewer is an open-source project in the visualization and tomography category. It is maintained by QCT-IQC and primarily looks like a C/C++ codebase. Go into the build directory and choose the folder corresponding to the build type you want.

For readers mapping the ecosystem, this resource is useful because it shows how one team approaches visualization and tomography workflows in practice. The repository README emphasizes: Go into the build directory and choose the folder corresponding to the build type you want. Enter the folder and run./build. libpoppler-glib-dev libgtkmm-2.4-dev bison flex cmake boost >= 1.52.0 libboost-dev libboost-filesystem-dev libboost-program-options-dev libboost-system-dev cairo >= 1.10.2 mpfr
whoItsFor: People who learn best by seeing state structure, measurement results, or circuit behavior laid out visually.
whatYouCanBuild: Understand how the project helps inspect or reconstruct quantum systems.
Compare visual tooling against more code-heavy workflows.
Use the resource as a bridge between theory, experiments, and debugging.
